name: org-todos
title: Org Todos
description: View, complete and create tasks stored in an Org-mode todos.org file
author: adienox

commands.name: list-tasks
commands.title: Todos
commands.subtitle: Org
commands.description: Browse tasks from your todos.org file, change their state, or open them in your editor

commands.name: agenda
commands.title: Agenda
commands.subtitle: Org
commands.description: Day-by-day agenda across all your org files: overdue, today, this week

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: New Todo
commands.subtitle: Org
commands.description: Append a new task to your todos.org file

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add Todo
commands.subtitle: Org
commands.description: Add a task in one line, e.g. "call supplier tomorrow p1 #work"

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Capture from Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Org
commands.description: Create a task from the clipboard: first line is the title, the rest becomes notes

preferences.name: todosFile
preferences.title: Todos File
preferences.description: Main todos file (~ is expanded). New tasks are written here.

preferences.name: extraFiles
preferences.title: Additional Files
preferences.description: Comma-separated extra .org files or directories to read tasks from

preferences.name: todoKeywords
preferences.title: TODO Keywords
preferences.description: Same format as #+TODO: — active states, a bar, then done states

preferences.name: archiveFile
preferences.title: Archive File
preferences.description: Where 'Archive Task' moves subtrees (~ is expanded). Created if missing.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor Command
preferences.description: Shell command used by 'Open in Editor'. {file} and {line} are substituted.
